title: Support your answer with an example
instruction: Watch Sarah answer interview questions. Explain how her skills and one real example support her application

items.prompt: What kind of organisation does Sarah work for?
items.answer: She works for a group of language schools

items.prompt: Why does Sarah think her experience is relevant to a different product?
items.hint: Focus on her abilities rather than the product
items.answer: She believes her existing skills can transfer to the new work

items.prompt: What is Sarah looking for in her next role?
items.hint: Think about the level of responsibility

items.prompt: How did Sarah deal with the two colleagues’ conflict, and what changed?
items.hint: Follow her action and the result
items.answer: She brought them together to discuss their differences. They worked together more successfully afterwards
